notes.title: Update #3
notes.content:
This update brings graphic improvements and a more enjoyable game atmosphere adding better textures, animations and sounds !

Update Notes:

- reworked buildings textures
- added new animated robots in non-battle cities
- added new sounds for robot shops and footsteps
- added icons for building mode
- fixed some flickering textures
- player now starts with 9 robots instead of none
- player now starts near a capital city

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29193323/d86664d14019e9b3c71dea37b160f9218bc81aa9.jpg[/img]
